title: UK Authorizes Falklands/Malvinas Oil Exploration, Escalating Tensions with Argentina
detail: UK Foreign Secretary authorized oil exploration in the Falklands/Malvinas, heightening territorial tensions with Argentina. The move drew sharp condemnation from Buenos Aires, which reaffirmed its sovereignty claim over the islands. The decision is seen as a provocation by Argentine officials and nationalist groups, reviving long-standing disputes over the South Atlantic territory.

media.caption: UK authorizes oil exploration in Falklands/Malvinas amid rising tensions with Argentina

title: UK Troops Conduct Falklands/Malvinas Invasion Simulation Exercises Amid Heightened Tensions
detail: British troops conducted military exercises simulating a potential Argentine invasion of the Falklands/Malvinas Islands, signaling heightened UK military readiness amid renewed territorial tensions. The drills come shortly after the UK authorized oil exploration in the disputed territory, prompting strong condemnation from Buenos Aires, which continues to assert sovereignty over the South Atlantic archipelago.

media.caption: UK troops simulate Argentine invasion of Falklands/Malvinas amid rising territorial tensions

title: INDEC: September Inflation Rises to 1.9%, Annual Rate 33.4%
detail: INDEC reported monthly consumer inflation of 1.9% in September, up from 1.7% in August, lifting the annual rate to 33.4% and year-to-date inflation to 23.6%. Core inflation eased to 1.7%. Housing and utilities (+3.1%) and education (+3.0%) rose fastest; food rose 2.0%.

media.caption: Argentina inflation ticks up to 1.9% in September
